::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
## Lifecycle authority

The accepted numerical operations, physical component models, units, evidence
workspace, and Result meanings remain `STABILIZED`. Acceptance and
stabilization are not release claims.

The public authoring grammar, structured Plan identity, certified diagrams,
and independent Parameter System are reopened in documentation-first targets.
[CircuitPlan Assembly](circuit-plan-assembly.qmd) owns the common model;
[Automatic Semantic Circuit Diagram Layout](automatic-semantic-circuit-diagram-layout.qmd)
owns composition and visual evidence; [Parameter System, Sweeps, and Bound
Results](parameter-system.qmd) owns definitions, physical bindings, points,
spaces, sweep Results, and optimization binding. These scopes remain
`CONVERGING` with an integrated implementation baseline, not Human acceptance.
:::

## Implementation and evidence status {#implementation-evidence-status}

The structured assembly, Parameter System, and diagram implementation baseline
is integrated. Ongoing public-contract corrections remain unaccepted candidate
work; neither integration nor passing checks promotes these scopes to
`ACCEPTED` or `STABILIZED`. The accepted numerical Full V1 meanings are retained.

Current CI exercises portable-wheel identity, a small current-API
Direct/pump-off HB/resolve smoke, runtime preparation, Notebook parity,
source-bound figures, static publication, and unchanged standalone RLGC rejection
and HB failure-classifier checks. Engineer Chapter 1 has one explicitly
generated source-bound authoring diagram, two typed-result S11 presentations,
complex response data, and a quantity table. Its web build launches no solver,
and those assets do not establish execution of every migration-legacy Chapter
or every compiled projection. The [figure inventory](../../examples/README.md)
records both current and legacy evidence.

The Chapter 12 tapped-feedline Default and complete explicit tap-order
checkpoints are now successful source-bound exports. One fixed-layout
limitation remains in the Tutorial inventory: Chapter 13's complete raw-loaded
Default reports `schematic_layout` with `fixed connector intersects occupied
geometry`. It has no current SVG or diagram certificate; the same Plan's
successful explicit composition and final probe-tee capstone remain separately
identified checkpoints rather than substitutes for that Default failure. The
[figure inventory](../../examples/README.md) records the exact current count.

Retained tests have three distinct evidence roles: current runnable checks;
numerical and integrity regressions blocked by superseded authoring fixtures;
and superseded historical expectations that are not current product authority.
Old-fixture failures do not invalidate downstream numerical assertions, and
historical expectations do not decide the unaccepted replacement semantics.
Their bodies remain historical evidence pending authorized stabilization; no
full historical-suite pass or whole-course execution is claimed. No release,
consumer migration, or scientific acceptance follows from this evidence.

Current structured `couple_inductive()` accepts a fixed Quantity only;
coupling-coefficient parameter binding and optimization are not supported.
The Runtime's illustrative optimization therefore varies capacitance only,
not the superseded two-variable example.

The model-first [Tutorial](../index.qmd) and
[Concept](../concepts/physical-authority-and-reusable-composition.qmd) explain
the reader workflow before these exact contracts: author one complete Plan,
inspect its ASCDLS projection, then independently select `run.original` or a
derived View for a numerical request. Diagram rendering never selects or
mutates that analysis View.

The [engineer-course migration map](../implementation/engineer-course-migration-map.qmd)
owns course placement only. It does not replace any Contract or implementation
authority on this page.

## Public contracts

Read these when deciding what a Notebook user may declare, execute, inspect,
and resolve.

- [Component Authoring Contract](../component-authoring.qmd) retains catalogs,
  physical component fields and public boundaries, RLGC, Josephson/SQUID,
  mutual coupling, and Direct/HB lowering semantics.
- [CircuitPlan Assembly](circuit-plan-assembly.qmd) defines root/inline/reusable
  assembly, equivalent ordinary public pins, open boundaries, completeness,
  and shared Plan identity for independent consumers.
- [Automatic Semantic Circuit Diagram Layout](automatic-semantic-circuit-diagram-layout.qmd)
  defines handle-based layout including named-tap presentation order,
  independent audits, and code-free review.
- [Parameter System, Sweeps, and Bound Results](parameter-system.qmd) defines
  independent input identities, physical Plan adoption, immutable points and
  spaces, batch Result inspection, optimization binding, and parameterized
  diagrams.
- [V1 Runtime Contract](../v1-runtime-contract.qmd) defines Runs, Refs, Specs,
  units, reduction, Direct/HB behavior, optimization, Results, attempts,
  receipts, failure, and known limits.

Public contracts own product semantics. An implementation page may explain a
mechanism, dependency, data layout, or delivery slice, but it cannot weaken or
replace a public invariant.
